description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractConverter' that implements conversion logic, including methods for registering converters and checking convertibility between source and target classes. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.conversion' package and provides a base implementation for converter classes in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: AbstractConverter
classes.description: An abstract base class for converters that handle type conversion, registration, and capability checks between source and target classes.

methods.name: loadConverters
methods.description: Registers this converter with the converter registry.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts an object to the specified target class, delegating to an abstract method (not shown).

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks if this converter can handle conversion between the specified source and target classes.

methods.name: getSourceClass
methods.description: Returns the source class type for this converter.

methods.name: getTargetClass
methods.description: Returns the target class type for this converter.
